prompt: Illustration painted on a WOOD PANEL, visible wood grain through matte paint. SIMPLE and CALM: big flat shapes, generous empty space, sparing line detail, naive storybook charm with gentle whimsy. NOT busy, NOT intricate. Palette strictly: pale bone-grey painted ground, FLAT solid black, white outline, and ONE accent of glowing BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN. TWO KINDS OF BEING ONLY: (1) small SOLID BLACK beings with curled spiral fiddlehead ears, and (2) tiny GLOWING GREEN unformed sprites, simple rounded shapes with a soft green glow. NO human figures anywhere. No text, no lettering, no glyphs. A row of four small simple cabins on flat pale ground under a big flat black sky, with one enormous fern behind them. Each cabin wears the SAME PRECISE INSTRUMENTS AS THE ANCIENT STONE, sparingly: a slim white band across one wall, one small white instrument box beside each door with a tiny green readout, and a single neat cable clipped down the wall and running into the ground; one shared white post carrying a small green-lit meter. Windows and doors are flat glowing green. Two black beings with spiral ears sit on a step; one tiny green sprite floats near a doorway. Quiet, tidy, lots of empty space.
